message:
The 1.9 Hz first mode sits squarely in the walking resonance band so Setra-type and Human-Induced Vibration of Steel Structures (HiVoSS) comfort checks govern, Structural Dynamicist and Bridge Retrofit Engineer.

In plain words the bridge will resonate with normal walking so Maximum comfort is below 0.5 metres per second squared, Medium comfort is 0.5 to 1.0 metres per second squared, Minimum comfort is 1.0 to 2.5 metres per second squared and Unacceptable is above 2.5 metres per second squared, which is the band stated in the Low-Cost Angular-Velocity Measurements for Sustainable Dynamic Identification of Pedestrian Footbridges: A Case Study of the Footbridge in Gdynia (Poland) (E33) and in the comfort-target concept (C13), while 1.9 Hz falling inside the 1.25 to 2.3 Hz critical vertical range is stated in the Human-Induced Vibration on Lightweight Footbridges — 2024 (E19).

In plain words holding Maximum below 0.5 metres per second squared instead of accepting Medium costs more damper mass, more units and harder under-deck maintenance for little perceived gain, Manager. The retrofitted acceleration of 0.668 metres per second squared from the retrofitted-acceleration calculation (E44) settling at 0.67 metres per second squared in the crowd build-up simulation (E45) is 0.068 times gravity and everyday footbridge feel, against 8.28 metres per second squared bare from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43) at 0.844 times gravity almost body weight and clearly outside everyday feel, so I accept Medium as the retrofit target with the twin 400 kg units from the per-unit mass split (E52) serviced from below by Below Bridge Access Vehicle, defined as Below Bridge Access Vehicle (BBAV), from the inspection-access rule (E49).

In plain words a measured walk-through must prove the band, not just calculate it, and the lift method confirms that split, Bridge Retrofit Engineer. I take from the Chapter 15 PDF (E60) that draft ISO 18738 Measurement of Lift Ride Quality establishes requirements, methodology and processing for acceleration evaluation but does not try to establish what is or is not acceptable, which confirms from my discipline that my Setra/HIVOSS crowd acceptance run with filed record (C29) should borrow the measurement method while the Maximum/Medium/Minimum bands set pass or fail, backed by the car-jury analogy (C30) with no deck-visible hardware (C28).

My position is not ready, because the Manager has not yet selected between Maximum and Medium comfort and the maintenance-access provision is still open.
